title: Curious Cursive Cuttlefish
statement: This palm-sized cuttlefish drifts through amber-lit seagrass, ripples looping, handwriting-like patterns across its skin whenever a visitor leans close, then tilts its head as if waiting for a reply. Between conversations it patiently sorts the pebbles around its sunken brass lantern into small, careful spirals, rearranging them whenever it decides they could be a little more just right.
